start_here: Say to your AI: "Silence the clicks and hiss in the pauses of my voice take /Work/demo/take.wav, writing /Work/demo/take.clean.wav." It runs tool:silence-the-ticks-in-a-generated-voice-takes-pauses on your computer and tells you how many pauses it silenced.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of yours: it reads a take on your computer and writes the cleaned wav you name.
instructions: 1. Install python3, numpy and soundfile, and clone the Workshop (git clone https://github.com/Trillion-X/trillion-workshop.git).

2. Your AI reads the row with tools:list and runs its run command on your computer: python3 trillion-workshop/tools/grade-and-repair-speech-audio/do-work/clean_voice_take_pauses.py /Work/demo/take.wav /Work/demo/take.clean.wav
3. Listen to take.clean.wav and use it in place of the take; the words themselves are not changed.

worked_examples.title: One take's pauses cleaned
worked_examples.ask: Clean the ticks out of my voice take's pauses.
worked_examples.given: A text-to-speech take /Work/demo/take.wav with clicks between its words.
